I am old now, 69 years, and this small plot near my house is just 0.06 hectares where I plant my cassava and cocoyam together with some vegetables. I cannot afford to buy chemical fertilizer for this small plot, but I have goat droppings and kitchen ash that I spread on the soil. I use the cassava stems from last year's harvest because they grow well here in our South South soil, and I do the work myself with help from my grandchildren when school is not in session. The rain here is plenty, so no need to carry water, and I just remove weeds with my hoe.
